__comment: Rudimentary room heater — an open fire on four flagstones against a stacked stone fire-back, with low wing stones and no wood of its own (docs 199, 279).
Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs (doc 256); the fire-back stands at local -Z and the fire faces +Z.
The fire-back reaches 1.81 blocks inside the 2x2x2 collision envelope.

RoomManager counts 9600 heat units once at the origin (owner, 2026-10-30: one hearth warms a bedroom of about 600 cells through the winter). Fires are tended to temperature.json's tended_fire_c, so a small room is not overheated.
Named body/flame meshes and ten voxel flame frames preserve installed lighting and animation; the flame burns below the fire-back's top.

A lit hearth emits warm, gently flickering light and heats its room; it is lit with a log at dusk, or at bedtime by a dwarf going to sleep in its room, and goes out at dawn or when its sleepers wake by day (doc 34). Ghosts and packed items remain unlit.
The shared packed-furniture item and floor-placement behavior are unchanged.
description: An open fire on flagstones against a stone fire-back that throws its heat into the room. A worker lights it at dusk with a log, and it burns until dawn. Warms a small enclosed bedroom; larger rooms may need more heat.
placement_note: Place inside an enclosed room, its fire-back to a wall. R turns the fire to face inward.

nightly_fire.__comment: Doc 279: as the campfire. The log lies across the ash before the fire-back, under the flame, set down from in front (light_from).
